main_text.head: IV. EPISTOLA HENRICI REGIS ad Daniæ Regem.
main_text.p: HENRICUS Dei gratia Navarrorum Rex, Princeps Bearniæ, Dux Vindocinensis, Belmontensis, Albretensis, Nemorensis, &c. Comes Toxensis, Armeniacus, Rhutenensis, Bigoronensis, Marlensis, Petragorensis, &c. Vicecomes Lemoricensis, &c. Serenissimo Principi Domino FREDERICO Dei gratia Daniæ, Norvegiæ, Gotthorum, Vandalorumque Regi, salutem in Domino & fœlicitatem perpetuam.

page.notes: Catchword "Sere-" is partly obscured. Small specks and stray marks on the scan are ignored. The heading "ad Daniæ Regem." is set in italic type; the word "Daniæ" is printed with a long-s style ligature.
